# redteam-suite

> Run a versioned battery of benign prompt injection, system prompt leak and jailbreak probes against a target you own and report findings. Python package `trysac-redteam-suite`, import name `redteam_suite`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example, public API

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model and limits
